Open a report or download its source.

```{r assignments, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
reports <- list.files("report", pattern = "\\.(Rmd|qmd)$", full.names = TRUE)
formats <- c(Rmd = "R Markdown (.Rmd)", qmd = "Quarto (.qmd)")
for (report in reports) {
    title <- rmarkdown::yaml_front_matter(report)$title
    if (is.null(title)) title <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(report))
    html <- sub("\\.(Rmd|qmd)$", ".html", report)
    source <- file.path("downloads", basename(report))
    cat(sprintf(
        "## %s\n\n[HTML report](%s) · [%s](%s){download=\"\"}\n\n",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(title),
        URLencode(html, reserved = FALSE),
        formats[[tools::file_ext(report)]],
        URLencode(source, reserved = FALSE)
    ))
}
```
